name: sidebar
useFor: Use for an app's main navigation beside the canvas (Ask, Map, Saved sites, Reports, then labelled groups such as Layers). Wrap the app in SidebarProvider; put the lockup in SidebarHeader, groups of SidebarMenuItem in SidebarContent and Help and the account in SidebarFooter. Mark the current row with isActive. Use collapsible="icon" to fold to glyphs (give each row a tooltip), variant="secondary" for a second rail of projects on the canvas, and SidebarMenuBadge for a count or a short mark. SidebarContent fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
source: Mireye docs site spec (the 212px Bone rail, square rows, framed group chips) and the rail's Fog hover and Mist current, for a designer's review
title: Sidebar
description: The app's rail: 212px of Bone with a 1px Stone edge, square 32px rows (Fog under the pointer, Mist when current), group labels as 1px-framed chips, a Forest count; it folds to glyphs, slides away or opens as a sheet on phones.
